commentary:
Attention was updated today - it is now v1, and the whole idea is one tap.

Run a focus session and log every interruption as it happens. Each log is a timestamp and a label, nothing else: no modal, no confirm, no pause. A 25-minute session with three interruptions logs three and still ends at 25 minutes, because logging a distraction should not cost you the session.

Then it shows where the drift actually happens - by hour of the day and by label, with your worst hour marked. That is the thing you cannot see from inside a single session.

What it deliberately will not do:
- No score, grade, rating or streak. No such field exists in the engine.
- No blocklist, no site blocking, no notifications, no policing of your time.
- If storage is full the session still runs, and the pattern is never computed from a session it could not keep.
- A corrupt saved ledger is reported and offered for export, never quietly replaced with an empty one.

It records and reports. The judging is yours.

Windows, Android and Linux builds. Offline, no account, no telemetry. PolyForm Noncommercial licence.

https://drsamonline.github.io/app-attention/
